name: password-requirements
purpose: Live checklist of password rules shown under a `PasswordInput`: a caption followed by one chip per rule, each chip turning to the success tone with a check as the typed value satisfies it. It replaces the requirements row of the v5 `field-password`; the entry also exports `DEFAULT_PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS` and the `PasswordRequirement` type so a form validates with the same rules it shows. `DEFAULT_PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS` is typed `PasswordPatternRequirement[]` (exported too): every built-in rule has a `key` and a `RegExp` `test`, so `rule.test.test(value)` type-checks without narrowing; a custom rule list stays `PasswordRequirement[]`, whose `test` may be a predicate.
useWhen: A new-password field (sign-up, reset, change password) where the user must meet explicit rules.
avoidWhen: A sign-in password field → render `password-input` alone; the rules do not apply to an existing password.
A free-form strength meter → not provided; compose your own.
related: password-input` — the control whose value this checklist evaluates.
field` — place both inside one `Field` so the label and description stay together.
bestPractices: Bind `value` to the same ref as the `PasswordInput` `v-model`.
Validate on submit with `DEFAULT_PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS` (or your own array) so the error and the chips never disagree.
Pass `requirements` to replace the rule set and `title` to localize the caption.

props.name: requirements
props.doc: Rules rendered as chips, one per entry. Defaults to the built-in rule set; an empty array renders only the caption.

props.name: title
props.doc: Caption that opens the row and names the group for assistive tech. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Must contain:`).

props.name: value
props.doc: Password every rule is evaluated against; pass the PasswordInput value.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import PasswordInput from '@aziontech/webkit/password-input'
  import PasswordRequirements from '@aziontech/webkit/password-requirements'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const password = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <Field
    required
    class="max-w-(--container-xs)"
  >
    <Field.Label>Password</Field.Label>
    <PasswordInput
      v-model="password"
      autocomplete="new-password"
    />
    <PasswordRequirements :value="password" />
  </Field>
</template>
